item.title: Land deal expands popular Wisconsin state park as Stewardship program remains in limbo
item.description: One of the largest remaining parcels of private land within Wisconsin’s most popular state park will be transferred to the state under a land deal funded through Wisconsin's contested land acquisition program. item.title: Former Green Bay council member sues city, mayor over years-old audio recording dispute
item.description: A former member of the Green Bay City Council is suing both the city and its mayor, claiming his constitutional rights were violated by the city’s use of audio recording devices in City Hall several years ago. item.title: ‘The government put me out of business’: Wisconsin hemp growers, sellers brace for new federal hemp law
item.description: Wisconsin hemp farmers and sellers are preparing for a new federal law that goes into effect this November and will change the definition of hemp. Many worry it will put them out of business. The post ‘The government put me out of business’: Wisconsin hemp growers, sellers brace for new federal hemp law appeared first on WPR.
